questionnaires.name: Renewal Questionnaire
questionnaires.description: Collects renewal rate changes, open enrollment details, and plan information from employers for COBRA administration. Responses drive updated payment coupons and participant notifications.

sections.section_description: COBRA participants and qualified beneficiaries must be given notification about open enrollment, rate changes, and benefit changes.

questionnaires.name: NDT — Organization Profile
questionnaires.description: Captures employer entity type, plan year, employee counts, controlled group status, and plan offerings. Complete this first — the answers determine which entity-specific NDT test questionnaires to attach.

fields.label: What type of business entity is this employer?
fields.help_text: This determines which version of each NDT test questionnaire to attach.

fields.label: Plan year start date
fields.help_text: First day of the Section 125 plan year.

fields.label: Plan year end date
Total W-2 employees as of the last day of the plan year
fields.help_text: Count ALL employees on payroll — full-time, part-time, seasonal, whether or not they participate in any benefit.

fields.label: Does this employer have related companies, a parent company, or subsidiaries?
fields.help_text: Under IRS controlled group rules (IRC §414), related employers may be treated as a single employer for testing.

fields.label: List each related company name and its W-2 employee count
fields.help_text: Include all entities under common ownership or an affiliated service group. Leave blank if no related companies.

fields.label: Does this employer offer pre-tax insurance premiums (Premium Only Plan)?
fields.help_text: Most Section 125 plans include this.

fields.label: Does this employer offer a Health FSA?
Does this employer offer a Dependent Care FSA?
Is the Health FSA self-insured?
fields.help_text: Almost all Health FSAs are self-insured (employer pays claims, not an insurance company). If yes, Section 105(h) testing also applies.

fields.label: Additional notes or explanations
The information provided is accurate to the best of my knowledge.

questionnaires.name: NDT — §125 Eligibility Test (C-Corporation)
questionnaires.description: Section 125 Cafeteria Plan Eligibility Test for C-Corporation employers. Tests whether a sufficient percentage of non-highly-compensated employees are eligible to participate. C-Corp owners participate as W-2 employees and can be HCEs or key employees.

sections.section_description: These are employees the IRS allows you to leave out of the eligibility test entirely.

fields.label: How many employees are covered by a collective bargaining agreement (union)?
fields.help_text: Exclude only if cafeteria plan benefits were the subject of good-faith bargaining between the employer and union.

fields.label: How many employees are non-resident aliens with no U.S. source income?
fields.help_text: These employees are excluded from testing by law.

fields.label: How many employees are under the plan's minimum age requirement?
fields.help_text: Enter 0 if your plan has no age requirement. Most plans that have one use age 21.

fields.label: How many employees have not met the plan's service requirement?
fields.help_text: Enter 0 if there is no waiting period. Common waiting periods are 30, 60, or 90 days.

fields.label: How many employees work fewer hours than the plan requires for eligibility?
fields.help_text: Enter 0 if the plan has no minimum hours requirement.

sections.section_description: A Highly Compensated Employee (HCE) is someone who earned more than the IRS threshold in the PRIOR plan year, OR who owns more than 5% of the company's stock.

fields.label: What is the prior plan year used for HCE lookback?
fields.help_text: If the current plan year is 2026, the prior year is 2025.

fields.label: Which IRS compensation threshold applies for the prior year?
fields.help_text: Use the threshold for the prior plan year, not the current year.

fields.label: Is the employer using the Top-Paid Group election?
fields.help_text: This optional election limits HCEs to only those in the top 20% of employees by compensation who also exceed the threshold. Check the plan document.

fields.label: How many employees earned above the HCE threshold in the prior year?
fields.help_text: Count only employees still employed during the current plan year.

fields.label: How many employees own more than 5% of the company's stock (directly or through family)?
fields.help_text: Include family attribution — a spouse's or child's stock ownership counts as yours under IRS rules.

fields.label: Total number of HCEs (employees who meet EITHER the compensation OR ownership test)
fields.help_text: Do not double-count — an employee who meets both tests is still one HCE.

sections.section_description: Count employees AFTER removing the excludable employees listed above.

fields.label: Total employees eligible for the Section 125 plan
fields.help_text: Total employees from Org Profile minus all excludable categories above.

fields.label: How many eligible employees are HCEs?
How many eligible employees are Non-HCEs?
fields.help_text: This should equal total eligible minus HCEs.

fields.label: Total employees who actually made Section 125 elections
fields.help_text: Anyone who elected pre-tax premiums, Health FSA, or Dependent Care FSA.

fields.label: How many participants are HCEs?
How many participants are Non-HCEs?
Additional notes or explanations
The information provided is accurate to the best of my knowledge.

questionnaires.name: NDT — §125 Eligibility Test (S-Corporation)
questionnaires.description: Section 125 Cafeteria Plan Eligibility Test for S-Corporation employers. S-Corp shareholders owning 2% or more CANNOT participate in Section 125 and must be excluded from the eligible employee group, though they may still be classified as HCEs for testing purposes.

sections.section_description: S-Corporation shareholders owning 2% or more CANNOT participate in a Section 125 plan. They must be removed from the eligible employee group before testing.

fields.label: How many shareholders own 2% or more of the S-Corp stock?
fields.help_text: These individuals cannot make pre-tax elections under Section 125. Include family attribution — a spouse's ownership is counted as yours.

fields.label: Of those 2%+ shareholders, how many are on the W-2 payroll?
fields.help_text: Only payroll employees matter for testing. Shareholders who are not on payroll are already outside the testing group.

sections.section_description: These are employees (other than 2%+ shareholders, already excluded above) the IRS allows you to leave out of the eligibility test.

fields.label: How many non-owner employees are covered by a collective bargaining agreement (union)?
fields.help_text: Exclude only if cafeteria plan benefits were the subject of good-faith bargaining.

fields.label: How many non-owner employees are non-resident aliens with no U.S. source income?
fields.help_text: Excluded from testing by law.

fields.label: How many non-owner employees are under the plan's minimum age requirement?
fields.help_text: Enter 0 if your plan has no age requirement.

fields.label: How many non-owner employees have not met the plan's service requirement?
fields.help_text: Enter 0 if there is no waiting period.

fields.label: How many non-owner employees work fewer hours than the plan requires?
fields.help_text: Enter 0 if the plan has no minimum hours requirement.

sections.section_description: Even though 2%+ S-Corp shareholders cannot participate, non-owner employees can still be HCEs based on compensation or ownership of less than 2% but more than 5% (rare with family attribution).

fields.label: What is the prior plan year used for HCE lookback?
fields.help_text: If the current plan year is 2026, the prior year is 2025.

fields.label: Which IRS compensation threshold applies for the prior year?
fields.help_text: Use the threshold for the prior plan year.

fields.label: Is the employer using the Top-Paid Group election?
fields.help_text: Limits HCEs to the top 20% by pay. Check the plan document.

fields.label: How many NON-OWNER employees earned above the HCE threshold in the prior year?
fields.help_text: Count only non-2%+ shareholder employees. The 2%+ shareholders are already excluded from the eligible group.

fields.label: Do any non-2% employees own more than 5% through family attribution?
fields.help_text: This is rare but possible. Example: an employee's spouse owns 6% of the S-Corp but the employee owns 0%. The employee is attributed the spouse's ownership.

fields.label: If yes, how many non-2% employees are HCEs through family attribution?
Total HCEs among the eligible (non-owner) employee group
fields.help_text: Count of non-owner employees who meet either the compensation or ownership test.

sections.section_description: Count employees AFTER removing 2%+ shareholders and other excludable employees.

fields.label: Total employees eligible for the Section 125 plan
fields.help_text: Total employees from Org Profile minus 2%+ shareholders on payroll minus all other excludable categories.

fields.label: How many eligible employees are HCEs?
How many eligible employees are Non-HCEs?
fields.help_text: Should equal total eligible minus HCEs.

fields.label: Total employees who actually made Section 125 elections
fields.help_text: Anyone who elected pre-tax premiums, Health FSA, or Dependent Care FSA.

fields.label: How many participants are HCEs?
How many participants are Non-HCEs?
Additional notes or explanations
The information provided is accurate to the best of my knowledge.

questionnaires.name: NDT — §125 Eligibility Test (LLC / Partnership / Sole Prop)
questionnaires.description: Section 125 Cafeteria Plan Eligibility Test for pass-through entities. Owners, members, and partners of LLCs, partnerships, and sole proprietorships CANNOT participate in Section 125 and are excluded from the eligible employee group entirely.

sections.section_description: Owners, members, and partners of pass-through entities CANNOT participate in a Section 125 plan and are removed from the testing group.

fields.label: Which type of pass-through entity is this?
How many owners/members/partners are on the W-2 payroll?
fields.help_text: All of these individuals are excluded from Section 125 participation regardless of their ownership percentage.

sections.section_description: Among the remaining non-owner W-2 employees, these are employees the IRS allows you to leave out of the eligibility test.

fields.label: How many non-owner employees are covered by a collective bargaining agreement (union)?
fields.help_text: Exclude only if cafeteria plan benefits were the subject of good-faith bargaining.

fields.label: How many non-owner employees are non-resident aliens with no U.S. source income?
fields.help_text: Excluded from testing by law.

fields.label: How many non-owner employees are under the plan's minimum age requirement?
fields.help_text: Enter 0 if your plan has no age requirement.

fields.label: How many non-owner employees have not met the plan's service requirement?
fields.help_text: Enter 0 if there is no waiting period.

fields.label: How many non-owner employees work fewer hours than the plan requires?
fields.help_text: Enter 0 if the plan has no minimum hours requirement.

sections.section_description: Only non-owner W-2 employees are tested. An HCE is someone who earned more than the IRS threshold in the prior year. Ownership-based HCE status does not apply since all owners are already excluded.

fields.label: What is the prior plan year used for HCE lookback?
fields.help_text: If the current plan year is 2026, the prior year is 2025.

fields.label: Which IRS compensation threshold applies for the prior year?
fields.help_text: Use the threshold for the prior plan year.

fields.label: Is the employer using the Top-Paid Group election?
fields.help_text: Limits HCEs to the top 20% by pay. Check the plan document.

fields.label: How many non-owner employees earned above the HCE threshold in the prior year?
fields.help_text: Count only non-owner W-2 employees.

fields.label: Total HCEs among the non-owner employee group
fields.help_text: For pass-through entities this is typically based on compensation only, since all owners are already excluded.

sections.section_description: Count employees AFTER removing all owners/members/partners and other excludable employees.

fields.label: Total non-owner employees eligible for the Section 125 plan
fields.help_text: Total employees from Org Profile minus owners on payroll minus all other excludable categories.

fields.label: How many eligible employees are HCEs?
How many eligible employees are Non-HCEs?
fields.help_text: Should equal total eligible minus HCEs.

fields.label: Total non-owner employees who actually made Section 125 elections
fields.help_text: Anyone who elected pre-tax premiums, Health FSA, or Dependent Care FSA.

fields.label: How many participants are HCEs?
How many participants are Non-HCEs?
Additional notes or explanations
The information provided is accurate to the best of my knowledge.

questionnaires.name: NDT — §125 Eligibility Test (Non-Profit / Government)
questionnaires.description: Section 125 Cafeteria Plan Eligibility Test for tax-exempt organizations (501(c)(3) non-profits and government entities). There are no owner exclusions. HCE status is based solely on compensation — there is no ownership test. Officers are NOT classified as key employees (relevant for Key Employee Concentration Test).

fields.label: Which type of tax-exempt organization is this?

sections.section_description: These are employees the IRS allows you to leave out of the eligibility test. There are no owner exclusions for tax-exempt organizations.

fields.label: How many employees are covered by a collective bargaining agreement (union)?
fields.help_text: Exclude only if cafeteria plan benefits were the subject of good-faith bargaining.

fields.label: How many employees are non-resident aliens with no U.S. source income?
fields.help_text: Excluded from testing by law.

fields.label: How many employees are under the plan's minimum age requirement?
fields.help_text: Enter 0 if your plan has no age requirement.

fields.label: How many employees have not met the plan's service requirement?
fields.help_text: Enter 0 if there is no waiting period.

fields.label: How many employees work fewer hours than the plan requires?
fields.help_text: Enter 0 if the plan has no minimum hours requirement.

sections.section_description: For non-profits and government entities, HCE status is based SOLELY on compensation. There is no ownership test because there are no owners.

fields.label: What is the prior plan year used for HCE lookback?
fields.help_text: If the current plan year is 2026, the prior year is 2025.

fields.label: Which IRS compensation threshold applies for the prior year?
fields.help_text: Use the threshold for the prior plan year.

fields.label: Is the employer using the Top-Paid Group election?
fields.help_text: Limits HCEs to the top 20% by pay. Check the plan document.

fields.label: How many employees earned above the HCE threshold in the prior year?
fields.help_text: This is the only HCE test for tax-exempt organizations — there is no ownership test.

fields.label: Total HCEs
fields.help_text: For tax-exempt entities, this equals the compensation-based count above.

sections.section_description: Count employees AFTER removing excludable employees. No owners to exclude for tax-exempt organizations.

fields.label: Total employees eligible for the Section 125 plan
fields.help_text: Total employees from Org Profile minus all excludable categories above.

fields.label: How many eligible employees are HCEs?
How many eligible employees are Non-HCEs?
fields.help_text: Should equal total eligible minus HCEs.

fields.label: Total employees who actually made Section 125 elections
fields.help_text: Anyone who elected pre-tax premiums, Health FSA, or Dependent Care FSA.

fields.label: How many participants are HCEs?
